_about: Reason codes -> English sentences. {param} placeholders are filled from the reason's params. Tone: warm, precise, never 'lucky'.

reasons.nakshatra_vivaha: The Moon is in {nakshatra}, one of the eleven nakshatras the texts approve for a wedding.
reasons.nakshatra_not_vivaha: The Moon's nakshatra ({nakshatra}) is not in the classical wedding list.
reasons.nakshatra_vivaha_secondary: {nakshatra} is accepted for weddings by Dharmasindhu when nothing afflicts it.
reasons.pushya_curse: Pushya is auspicious for almost everything except marriage, so it is counted against this slot.
reasons.nakshatra_rejected: {nakshatra} is explicitly rejected for weddings (fierce or sharp nakshatra).
reasons.magha_mula_first_pada: The first pada of Magha and Mula is avoided for weddings.
reasons.tithi_good: {tithi} is a favourable tithi for this event.
reasons.rikta_tithi: {tithi} is a Rikta (empty) tithi, avoided for beginnings.
reasons.tithi_avoid_vivaha: Ashtami and Purnima are avoided for weddings in Raman's tradition.
reasons.purnima_avoid: Purnima is avoided for house entry.
reasons.shukla_paksha: The bright fortnight (Shukla paksha) strengthens a beginning.
reasons.shukla_paksha_extra: Shukla paksha is preferred for this samskara.
reasons.vara_good: {vara} is a gentle weekday for this event (weekday carries the least weight).
reasons.vara_avoid: {vara} is a fierce weekday, counted lightly against this slot.
reasons.vara_saturday_north: Saturday is skipped for house entry in North Indian practice.
reasons.masa_excellent: {masa} is one of the months the texts rate best for this event.
reasons.masa_good: {masa} is a favourable month for this event.
reasons.masa_avoid: {masa} is a month usually avoided for house entry.
reasons.sarvartha_siddhi: Sarvartha Siddhi yoga: this weekday and nakshatra together are said to accomplish all aims.
reasons.amrita_siddhi: Amrita Siddhi yoga is running (weekday and nakshatra pairing).
reasons.siddha_yoga: Siddha yoga: this weekday and tithi pair well.
reasons.ravi_yoga: Ravi yoga (the Moon's nakshatra counted from the Sun's) overrides many minor doshas.
reasons.abhijit: Abhijit muhurta, the eighth muhurta around local noon, favours this slot.
reasons.amrit_kaal: Amrit kaal (the nectar window of this nakshatra) is running.
reasons.choghadiya_good: The choghadiya is {choghadiya}, a favourable one.
reasons.tara_good: Tara bala is favourable from your birth nakshatra.
reasons.tara_bad: Tara bala is unfavourable from your birth nakshatra (Vipat, Pratyari or Vadha tara).
reasons.chandra_good: Chandra bala is good: the Moon is well placed from your birth rashi.
reasons.chandra_avoid: Chandra bala is weak: the Moon is in the 4th, 8th or 12th from your birth rashi.
reasons.panchaka: Panchaka is running (Moon in the last five nakshatras), observed in North India.
reasons.panchaka_south_travel: Panchaka: travel towards the south is avoided.
reasons.panchaka_pillar: Panchaka: raising pillars and roofing are avoided.
reasons.inauspicious_yoga: {yoga} yoga is one of the nine yogas avoided for beginnings.
reasons.vara_tithi_dosha: This weekday and tithi form a Dagdha, Visha or Hutashana combination.
reasons.mrityu_yoga: Mrityu yoga: this weekday and tithi group are a poor match.
reasons.yamaghanta: Yamaghanta: this weekday and nakshatra are avoided, especially for travel.
reasons.varjyam: Varjyam (tyajya) of this nakshatra is running.
reasons.bhadra_other_loka: Bhadra is running but resides in {loka} loka, which is harmless; noted for your pandit.
reasons.nakshatra_dhruva: {nakshatra} is a Dhruva (fixed) nakshatra, ideal for anything meant to last.
reasons.nakshatra_not_griha: {nakshatra} is not in the house-entry list.
reasons.nakshatra_ugra_tikshna: {nakshatra} is a fierce or sharp nakshatra, never used for auspicious work.
reasons.nakshatra_unlisted: {nakshatra} is not in the preferred list for this event.
reasons.pushya_business: Pushya is the first choice for starting a business.
reasons.ravi_guru_pushya: Ravi Pushya or Guru Pushya yoga: excellent for trade and purchases.
reasons.abujha_muhurta: This is an abujha (self-proven) day; no muhurta needs to be sought.
reasons.gand_mool: The Moon is in a Gand Mool nakshatra.
reasons.janma_nakshatra_avoid: The Moon is in your own birth nakshatra (Janma tara), avoided for this rite.
reasons.uttarayana: The Sun is in Uttarayana, preferred for samskaras.
reasons.hora_mercury_jupiter: The hora belongs to Mercury or Jupiter, good for learning.
reasons.pushkara_asset: Tripushkara or Dwipushkara yoga: what is acquired now is said to multiply.
reasons.guru_asta: Jupiter is combust (within {separation}° of the Sun): weddings are not held.
reasons.shukra_asta: Venus is combust (within {separation}° of the Sun): weddings are not held.
reasons.adhika_masa: This is an Adhika (extra) month, when auspicious ceremonies are not begun.
reasons.kharmas: Kharmas: the Sun is in {sunRashi} (Dhanu or Meena), a month-long pause for weddings and house entry.
reasons.chaturmas: Chaturmas (Devshayani to Devutthani Ekadashi): weddings and house entry wait until Vishnu wakes.
reasons.holashtak: Holashtak, the eight days before Holi, are avoided.
reasons.pitru_paksha: Pitru paksha, the fortnight of the ancestors, is not used for beginnings.
reasons.eclipse_day: An eclipse falls on this day.
reasons.eclipse_window: Within the avoided window around an eclipse ({daysFromPeak} days from it).
reasons.sankranti_window: Too close to the {rashi} sankranti (the Sun's sign change).
reasons.amavasya: Amavasya: no beginnings are made on the new-moon tithi.
reasons.bhadra_martya: Bhadra (Vishti karana) in martya loka: the strongest daily block for auspicious work.
reasons.vyatipata_vaidhriti: {yoga} yoga is avoided for all beginnings.
reasons.gandanta: Gandanta: the Moon is at the junction of a water and a fire sign.
reasons.chandrashtama: Chandrashtama: the Moon is in the 8th from your birth rashi, a hard block.

caveats.family_pandit: Treat this as a shortlist. Your family purohit knows your gotra, sutak and kula-achara, which no app can.
caveats.lagna_shuddhi_v3: Lagna shuddhi (the 21 mahadoshas of the wedding lagna) is not checked yet; ask your pandit to fix the lagna.
caveats.partner_bala_v3: Only one person's Tara and Chandra bala are used; the partner's will be added later.
caveats.weekday_least_weight: The weekday is the least-weighted limb; Guru/Shukra asta and Bhadra are the strongest blocks.
caveats.vastu_shanti_before: Perform Vastu shanti before entering; enter right foot first with the kalasha.
caveats.lagna_fixed_sign_v3: A fixed-sign lagna is preferred; lagna is not computed yet.
caveats.general_pack: This event uses the general rule pack: nakshatra lists are from the texts, but it is not yet tuned as finely as the wedding and house-entry packs.
caveats.purnimanta_month_name: North Indian (purnimanta) month names are shown; Gujarati, Marathi and South Indian calendars name the Krishna paksha by the previous month.
caveats.birth_time_unknown: Birth time unknown: the Moon stayed in one nakshatra that day, so the result is reliable.
caveats.birth_time_unknown_ambiguous: Birth time unknown and the Moon changed nakshatra that day: both candidates are shown, results are approximate.
caveats.no_birth_details: Add birth details to include Tara bala and Chandra bala.
caveats.drive_east_or_north_first: Drive first towards the east or north.
caveats.abhijit_wednesday: Abhijit is not used on Wednesdays in many lineages.
caveats.sthira_lagna_v2: A fixed (sthira) lagna window will be added when lagna is computed.
caveats.gujarati_new_year: Bestu Varas: the Gujarati Vikram Samvat begins today.
caveats.chaturmas_ends_weddings_resume: Chaturmas ends; the wedding season begins.
